Misconception: MaE44

Struggling with independent/dependent variables

What's happening here?

This is a common misconception where students have difficulty identifying which variable depends on the other. Understanding the relationship between variables is crucial for algebra.

Feedback for Improvement

The dependent variable (output) changes based on the independent variable (input). Think about cause and effect - which variable controls the other?

Practice Exercise

Try this exercise to practice identifying dependent and independent variables.
